preconditions.description: The input integer n must be between 4 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n lines, each representing a row of the grid.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line in the output must contain exactly n space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(num) < n**2 for num in stdout.replace(' ', ''))

postconditions.description: The bitwise XOR of all elements in each row and each column must be the same.
